_README: Plugins deliberately left un-rolled-out / un-enabled. Read by
scripts/check-plugin-rollout.py (see its load_parked docstring).
An entry moves that plugin's rollout/enablement findings out of the red
lists into a 'PARKED ON PURPOSE' report. It does NOT change the exit code,
and it does not excuse source-tree defects (a missing bin/<crate> launcher)
or a removable superseded cache dir.
Required per entry: reason, parked_at (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional: revisit — the
starting point for reconsidering the park (a backlog id, a doc, a signal to
watch for). The key must name a crate dir or a plugin.json name under
crates/; a typo is reported, not ignored, because a typo'd park parks
nothing while reading as though it had.
Deleting an entry is how a park ends. Resolve the reason FIRST, then delete
— not the other way round (backlog a6f165cd).
The current entry is parallelguard, parked 2026-08-28 for ENABLEMENT only:
the user ruled it stays `false` in settings.json. It is still rolled out on
every run, so its bytes stay current; what is parked is arming it.
The previous entry was taintguard, parked 2026-08-04 while its
false positive eb39308e was open, then unparked the same day when it rolled
out at 0.1.10. That crate was REMOVED from the repo entirely on 2026-08-24
by user ruling, so neither the park nor its observe-only posture exists any
more; this file is about DEPLOYMENT only and holds no entry for it.
The checker itself warns when an entry suppresses nothing: a stale park
silences a future red.

parallelguard.reason: ENABLEMENT parked by user ruling 2026-08-28: it stays set to false in ~/.claude/settings.json. The gate is installed and rolled out (its bytes are kept current by every rollout run) but deliberately inert — none of its hooks fire. This park covers ONLY the 'GATE crate is not enabled' finding; a rollout/currency red for parallelguard is still a real red and must not be read as parked. Do not flip it to true to clear the report — that is the 2026-08-04 taintguard mistake this file exists to prevent.
parallelguard.revisit: The user's own decision is the only trigger. Ask before unparking; there is no metric here that unparks itself.
